run_data_preprocess: run the script to preprocess a TU graph dataset like ENZYMES into train test and valid JSON files
run_kfold_split: run the 10-fold cross-validation split on a TU graph dataset and save train test valid JSON files per fold
run_one_hot_vec: run the one_hot_vec function to create a one-hot encoded vector of a given length at a specified position
review_data_preprocess: review the data_preprocess script that extracts edges node features and targets from PyTorch Geometric TUDataset graphs
refactor_one_hot_vec: refactor the one_hot_vec function to use numpy instead of a manual list-based implementation
